pages.title: Жетоны мастерства
pages.text: $(item)Жетоны мастерства$() are a necessary evil in making both the $(item)Жертвенный звездный двигатель$(), and a few other things in the endgame.$(br2)You will need to craft 88 $(item)Finalized Жетоны мастерства$().

pages.title: Жетоны мастерства
pages.text: Each token poses its own automation challenges.$(br2)If you have been diligent in your automation efforts so far, the tokens of the earlier simulations should be a lot easier to complete.$(br2)We recommend setting up a dedicated $(item)Industrial Assembler$() for each token type.$(br2)The next chapter will give endgame automation advice.
